8026.title: Completion timestamps are absent from sibling ordering
8026.rootCauseOneLine: Successful child completion preserves unread attention; the sidebar sorts by that clock and never receives the stored transition timestamp.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed, unmerged; coordinated server/client/SDK timestamp changes, not executed.

8026.proposedFix: Transport the existing durable activity timestamp separately from unread attention, then use it for inactive descendant sorting. This requires coordinated contracts and is not an autopilot-simple fix.
8026.caveats: Database/model reproduction only; no live desktop or provider run. Second clean reproduction performed by the same agent. Evidence is embedded in HTML; no standalone artifacts are published.
